description: ol-reserved-word (issue #427, M4 audit): `struct grid [ x ]` redefines `grid`, a Geometry overlay primitive (spec/geometry-module.md's `## grid`). The static checker flags the struct type name at its own span -- the static counterpart to the runtime fixture `data/struct-runtime/struct-reserved-word-geometry-grid`. SCOPE, CORRECTED: this used to say the verdict is "gated on the active `geometry` profile", which describes shipped behaviour rather than the rule. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY, and `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:382), so a conforming 0.4.0 implementation raises here with or without `geometry` claimed and this fixture's assertion is correct for both readings. Retiring the shipped gate is issue #841. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "primitive"` param (spec/error-model.md:125).
